claim_tested: Is enough of JIP4 ordered for a structure search to be meaningful?
key_finding: 241/876 residues (27.5%) at smoothed pLDDT>=70 in 4 segments (183-222, 270-310, 382-487, 579-632); mean pLDDT 55.10, median 43.64, 57.5% of residues below 50. PAE groups the first three into one module (mutual mean PAE 3.9-8.9 A) and leaves 579-632 independent (27.9-29.8 A).
context: S. cerevisiae Q03361, AlphaFold2 monomer model
confidence_limitations: High confidence in the segment call; pLDDT is a predictor, not an experimental order measurement.

claim_tested: Does the ordered part of JIP4 have a recognisable fold?
key_finding: Query 183-487 hits 1MJH_A (MJ0577, ATP-bound USP) E=5.0e-5 prob=1.0, 3HGM_B TeaD E=1.2e-4, 4R2L UspF E=6.7e-4, 3S3T UspA E=7.6e-4, 3TNJ USP+AMP E=8.6e-4; AFDB-SwissProt best hits YOR019W E=1.8e-24, YGR237C E=7.7e-11, S. pombe O74782 E=4.7e-10.
confidence_limitations: E-values are Foldseek-internal; corroborated independently by Pfam clan membership (E7).

claim_tested: Is the matched fold a nucleotide-binding USP fold?
key_finding: MJ0577 solved at 1.7 A with bound ATP; the paper assigns ATP-binding motifs shared across the homologous family.
confidence_limitations: Archaeal protein; family members vary in whether they retain ATP binding.

citation: Kabsch superposition on the Foldseek alignment (computational, this work)
claim_tested: Does the JIP4 model superpose on MJ0577 at atomic accuracy?
key_finding: 79 of 131 aligned CA pairs within 4 A after iterative trimming, core RMSD 1.55 A, mapping JIP4 270-471 onto MJ0577 4-157.
confidence_limitations: Superposition of a predicted model onto a crystal structure; the trimmed 52 pairs are the divergent loops.

citation: Ligand transplantation clash test (computational, this work)
claim_tested: Could JIP4 bind ATP the way MJ0577 does?
key_finding: ATP placed in the JIP4 frame by the same transform gives 12 clashing heavy atoms within 2.5 A (His277 x6, Ile278, Ser279, Thr284, Asn307 x2, Ser438) against 0 for MJ0577 with its own ligand. The MJ0577 G127-S128-H129-G130-K131-T132 loop corresponds to JIP4 S438-T439-L440-R441-W442-E443-R444-T445, both glycines substituted.
context: static AF model, no sidechain relaxation
confidence_limitations: A predicted model can misplace sidechains; the result shows the site is not preformed, it does not prove ATP cannot bind after induced fit.

claim_tested: Does the second ordered module (PF29925) have an assignable fold?
key_finding: Self hit E=5e-6; nothing below E=1 in AFDB-SwissProt or AFDB-proteome; best PDB100 hit 1ZDC (Z34C mini-domain) E=1.44, prob 0.86.
confidence_limitations: Short queries have low Foldseek power, so this is weak negative evidence, not a demonstration of novelty.

claim_tested: Is the USP call independent of Foldseek?
key_finding: Pfam places PF29926 (JIP4 N-terminal domain, 184-490) in clan CL0039 'HUP', the same clan as PF00582 'Universal stress protein family'. Hit-class composition at E<1e-3 is 58.3% USP (pdb100, 7/12), 81.8% (afdb-swissprot, 27/33), 67.2% (afdb-proteome, 88/131), with zero class I aaRS and zero PP-loop ATPase hits, resolving the clan to the UspA branch.
confidence_limitations: Clan membership alone does not pick a branch; the branch call rests on hit composition.

citation: InterPro records for Q99248 and P87132 (database-level)
claim_tested: Is the same region called UspA in JIP4's relatives by sequence methods?
key_finding: YOR019W carries SSF52402 (239-366) and PTHR47815 'Universal Stress Protein A' (234-436); S. pombe P87132 carries PF00582 (437-569), CDD cd23659, Gene3D G3DSA:3.40.50.620 'HUPs', PRINTS PR01438 UNVRSLSTRESS and SSF52402.
context: five independent sequence methods in two relatives
confidence_limitations: JIP4 itself falls below these methods' thresholds, which is why structure search was needed.

claim_tested: Are JIP4's spliceosome annotations experimentally grounded?
key_finding: Five annotations total: GO:0003674, GO:0008150, GO:0005575 all ND from SGD, plus GO:0005681 'spliceosomal complex' (CC) and GO:0048024 'regulation of mRNA splicing, via spliceosome' (BP), both IBA from GO_Central under GO_REF:0000033. No experimental annotation exists.
confidence_limitations: None; this is the current annotation record.

claim_tested: Is the IBA donor family a valid basis for propagating splicing terms to JIP4?
key_finding: PTHR23148 has six reviewed members: SRRM1 of human Q8IYB3, mouse Q52KI8, chicken Q5ZMJ9, orangutan Q5R5Q2, S. pombe PWI protein Q9USH5, and Q03361. All five non-JIP4 members carry a PWI domain (IPR002483/PF01480/SM00311/SSF101233); Q03361 carries none and instead carries PF29926 and PF29925, found only in S. cerevisiae YOR019W and YGR237C.
confidence_limitations: Reviewed members only; the unreviewed membership is larger but unannotated.

claim_tested: Does JIP4 share the SR-protein repeat architecture?
key_finding: Exactly one RS/SR repeat of >=3 units in JIP4: (RS)5 at 343-352, mean pLDDT 33.4, inside the low-confidence insertion 311-381 (mean pLDDT 45.1) that interrupts the folded USP module. Zero such repeats in YOR019W, YGR237C, Npl3, Gbp2 and Hrb1. No RD/DR repeats in any of the six. Relaxed R/S-rich windows: JIP4 318-371 and 671-726; YGR237C 106-145; none in the others.
confidence_limitations: A single 10-residue repeat is far below the metazoan SRRM1 RS-domain scale.

citation: ELM-pattern scan with composition-matched shuffles (computational, this work)
claim_tested: Do the disordered regions carry short linear interaction motifs above chance?
key_finding: 12 ELM classes scanned in the 626 disordered residues of JIP4 and the 482 of YOR019W. Observed counts match the null from 1000 composition-preserving shuffles: best raw p = 0.027 (LIG_FFAT_rel, JIP4, n=2), and 0 of 24 tests reach BH q < 0.05 (minimum q = 0.449).
confidence_limitations: Regex scanning has low specificity by construction; absence of enrichment does not exclude a motif that regexes cannot express.

claim_tested: Do the in vivo phosphosites point to a regulatory kinase route shared with SR proteins?
key_finding: Six of seven annotated sites lie in disorder. S51, S552 and S577 fit CK2 (S-x-x-D/E); S48 fits CK1 priming; S360 has Arg at -3 (basophilic); S510 and S775 match no consensus. No proline-directed (CDK/MAPK) site, and no site matches the SRPK/Sky1 RS-tract context.
confidence_limitations: Consensus matching assigns a kinase class, not a kinase.

claim_tested: Does experimental yeast work assign JIP4 a function?
key_finding: 'Protein of unknown function', merged from YDR474C and YDR475C; MF, BP and CC all ND. Null viable; phenotypes limited to decreased competitive fitness, altered chemical excretion and resistance, haploinsufficiency. 94 interactions, 22 physical, none spliceosomal.
confidence_limitations: Absence of a classical phenotype is consistent with redundancy with YOR019W.

claim_tested: Does the paralog YOR019W have an experimental function that JIP4 might share?
key_finding: Genome-wide mitophagy screen identified 32 mitophagy-defective mutants beyond the known ATG genes; YOR019W is the SGD-cited source for GO:0000422 (IMP). The paper characterised only YLR356W/ATG33 in detail.
confidence_limitations: Screen-level hit; no mechanism and no assay was performed on JIP4 itself.

claim_tested: Same as E15, alternative paralog activity.
key_finding: Ribosome-associated uncharacterised yeast proteins identified by co-purification; the source for YOR019W's possible ribosome association.
confidence_limitations: Co-purification with ribosomes is a common artefact for basic, disordered proteins.
